reviewNotes: Twenty-five object strings covering fossils, cooked dishes, geodes, a crystal, fruit salad, a forging resource, and garlic were translated directly from English. Two full editorial audits cover fossil anatomy, established recipe and item names, geode processing, forging quantities, item gender, and approved glossary terminology; both found no remaining objective issue.

FossilizedTail_Description.source: This tail has a club-like feature at the tip.
FossilizedTail_Description.translation: Această coadă are la vârf o formațiune asemănătoare unei măciuci.

FossilStone_Description.source: Break apart to obtain fossils and bones.
FossilStone_Description.translation: Sparge-o pentru a obține fosile și oase.

FriedMushroom_Description.translation: Cu gust de pământ și aromată.

FrozenGeode_Description.source: A blacksmith can break this open for you.
FrozenGeode_Description.translation: Un fierar o poate sparge pentru tine.

FrozenGeodeStone_Description.source: Break apart to obtain frozen geodes.
FrozenGeodeStone_Description.translation: Sparge-o pentru a obține geode înghețate.

FrozenTear_Description.source: A crystal fabled to be the frozen tears of a yeti.
FrozenTear_Description.translation: Un cristal despre care se spune că ar fi lacrimile înghețate ale unui yeti.

FruitSalad_Description.source: A delicious combination of summer fruits.
FruitSalad_Description.translation: O combinație delicioasă de fructe de vară.

GalaxySoul_Description.source: Forge 3 of these into a Galaxy weapon to unleash its final form.
GalaxySoul_Description.translation: Forjează trei astfel de suflete într-o armă a Galaxiei pentru a-i dezlănțui forma finală.
